input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: changepoint-detector (flagship 4, allocate.py row 2): a synthetic-control placebo statistic that does not divide by a tiny before-gap

doc_friction.issue: Foreground sleep is blocked by the harness; waiting on a long background simulation needs an until-loop under run_in_background (a foreground until-loop with a 600 s timeout was moved to the background). Not documented in cloud-session.md's 'Long commands'.

goal: Deepen a flagship: synthetic control inference robust to near-exact donor fits
notes: Pre-registration committed (e450c4e51) after a 100-panel exploratory run and before the 400-panel confirmatory run and the real states. Sim bars 1-3 hold (size 2.3-5.3% at p 0.05 and up to 14.0% at p 0.10 in N6, exactly at the cap; E1 5.8% against 6%; power P1 56.5 vs 33.8%, P6 45.5 vs 18.8%). Real: California 1989 rank 1 of 39 p 0.026 (was 3rd under the paper's ratio); in-time placebos and nine placebo states hold; T2-T4 (MA, AZ, OR) 0 of 3 at p 0.10, so per the pre-registration the module default became 'floored' and the CLI option did not ship. Seeds now hashed; the paper's ratio holds 3.0% in N1 with hashed seeds (consistent with last round's 5.5% being a seed artefact). Older scripts pass statistic 'ratio' and reproduce their committed tables (diffed). Verification: node --test synth-control.test.mjs 8/8; run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector ok (816 tests, 316 s); venture-preflight.mjs changepoint-detector clean after merging main (first attempt stopped on launched.json key order, already fixed on main).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
